list_pretrained_models: list all available pretrained CLIP model names and their pretrain tags
list_pretrained_tag_models: list all model architectures that have a given pretrain tag like openai
list_pretrained_model_tags: list all pretrain tags available for a specific model architecture like ViT-B-32
get_pretrained_url: get the download URL for a pretrained model given its architecture and tag
download_pretrained: download a pretrained CLIP model weights file from a URL with SHA256 checksum verification
